# Security

Report a vulnerability by email to **hello@memdoor.ai**, not in a public
issue. Say what you found, how to reproduce it and the version
(`memdoor --version`). You will get an answer within a few days, and credit
in the fix if you want it.

Where your data goes, and every host the binary can contact, is documented
in [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md); a test fails the build when a new
host is added.
